existing_bundle_approval_records.ABE: See original README and closure receipt

approval_reconciliation: Input bundles contain historical local-only/pending-approval statements; current retrieval plus user report establishes public availability, not an independently recovered later authorization receipt. Existing f75 publication scope applies only to its adopted packet. No approval is inferred for this new integration or the full local Level1 review.
disclosure_risks: Environment hostnames, scientific series/cohort existence and public repository provenance become easier to correlate.
Public catalog fingerprints and current unavailable-commit metadata are summarized; unavailable private bodies are not included.
A locally supplied Level1 review filename/hash/section mapping is recorded without its full body or a public fixed commit.
Scientific limitations and unresolved evidence states are consolidated; they are not newly adopted conclusions.
excluded: private configuration bodies and canonical locators
raw archives or unprocessed scientific payloads
private grants/receipts and internal absolute paths
full local Level1 review and unpublished drafts
required_user_decision: Approve the explicit new integration directory/files if publication is desired; no push while pending.
after_approval_owner: Codex in a separate authorized step: push this dedicated branch without rewriting history, verify remote commit and file bytes.
